messages:
Caroline D: Heads-up — Node SDK is missing the 'bulk_embedding' REST endpoint that the quickstart guides reference. New customers hit this during onboarding and end up using raw curl. Repro + minimal examples below.

Caroline D: REST curl that works for bulk embeddings:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","inputs":["a","b","c"]}'
```

Caroline D: Node SDK attempt (what people try, fails with 404):
```js
const r = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new r.Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.embeddings.bulk({ modelId: 'embed-large-v2', inputs: ['a','b','c'] });
// -> 404, endpoint not found
```

Mike H: Ah, thanks for flagging. Interesting — I thought we had a batch embeddings wrapper. Are we using a different API surface for SDKs?

Caroline D: Looks like SDKs have single-item embeddings only (client.embeddings.create) and a batching helper for streaming clients, but nothing that maps to the REST /embeddings/bulk shape. Docs call out bulk in quickstart so it's confusing.

Julia R: Also saw auth/retry differences here — REST curl gets 401->retry handled by our infra, but SDK surfaces an immediate error for the same token expiry case because the helper middleware doesn't refresh ephemeral creds. Might be two separate issues colliding.

Samir: Repro'd locally. The SDK method names differ and param names are inconsistent: REST expects 'model' and 'inputs', SDK expects 'modelId' + 'items'. That's causing more onboarding friction than the missing endpoint itself.

Aaron L: Filed an internal issue: INF-7231. I'll add the quick repro and a suggested SDK signature that mirrors REST: embeddings.bulk({ model, inputs }). Also tagging @eng-ml for compatibility review.

devex-bot: Issue created: INF-7231 — "Node SDK parity: bulk embeddings endpoint and param drift" (<https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-7231>) by Aaron L

Mike H: For a quick workaround we can add a small shim in the Node SDK package: client.embeddings.bulk = (opts) => client.embeddings.createBatch({ modelId: opts.model || opts.modelId, items: opts.inputs || opts.items }) — commit and publish a patch with a deprecation note.

Caroline D: Perfect, thanks. Can someone throw that on a hotfix branch and ping me? I'll update the quickstart to reference the SDK patch until we have the stable parity change. :thumbsup:

Aaron L: Will do. Pushing PR and CCing @docs to avoid more confused users.

Julia R: FYI, I'll follow up on the auth middleware separately — seems like retry/refresh codepath is triggered differently for SDK http client vs our infra gateway.

Caroline D: Thanks all — saved a customer call. If you want, I'll paste the exact error traces from onboarding session in INF-7231.
